[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-9k[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Pomodoro homes — derived area and project labels and stats[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every Pomodoro is labeled, on every surface, by the areas and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]projects of the tasks it links. The labels are derived at read time[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from Task Links and never written to the vault. `bob stats` and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`dash_stats.md` aggregate time and task throughput by area and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]project. `rollup: subprojects` on `sase.md` reports every sase [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sub-project as `sase`. Authored names keep working exactly as they [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]do today, but naming a session becomes optional.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared homes resolver, rollup switch, contract, and vault [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]config[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]homes-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]homes-core: build the one Rust resolver for task homes, session links, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]review sessions, splitting, labels, chips, and hues. Parse and lint [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`rollup` and area `color`. Write the normative docs/pomodoro-homes.md [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the shared conformance vectors, show the rollup flag in `bob [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]projects list`, and configure sase.md and the six top-level area notes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Area and project parts in bob stats[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stats-parts[dim] · [dim][/dim]after homes-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stats-parts: index closed-session links in the stats pass and add area [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and project parts to the pomodoro and task metrics, with buckets, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]homes catalog, apportioned minutes, and health. Print every parts [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dimension in the CLI. Add an H-vector fixture vault and update [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs/stats.md.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pomodoro in/review filters and session drill-down data[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stats-drilldown[dim] · [dim][/dim]after stats-parts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stats-drilldown: add the pomodoro `in:`, `exclude_in`, and `review:` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]filters, put review_time on the review predicate (per decision), and add[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the top-level `sessions` list that the panel drill-down reads. Add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vectors and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Homes on capture-pomodoros, bob plan, and bob pomodoro[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]live-surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after homes-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]live-surfaces: add an additive `homes` object to capture-pomodoros [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]--tasks entries and to bob plan JSON entries, and dim chips to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-pomodoros human output. Make `bob pomodoro` print the derived [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]label for unnamed sessions. Update the chezmoi menu-bar spec and tests, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the docs, and the mac pom glossary.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Obsidian ledger home chips[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ledger-chips[dim] · [dim][/dim]after homes-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ledger-chips: add a bob-ledger-tools JavaScript mirror of the resolver [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that runs the shared vectors verbatim. Draw quiet lowercase home chips [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on Pomodoro entry lines in Live Preview and Reading view, with the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]area-hue CSS tokens, the suppression rules, and a toggle. Then sync the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plugins.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Where the time went panel on dash_stats.md[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stats-panel[dim] · [dim][/dim]after stats-drilldown, ledger-chips[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stats-panel: replace the "by theme" pomodoro context panel with an Areas[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]& projects view (area bar, projects grouped by area, apportioned tint, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]buckets, drill-down, pinned-day filter) and keep Themes one click away. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Show the same table for task metrics, add preview fixtures and tests, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]then sync.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture agenda shows homes[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]mac-agenda[dim] · [dim][/dim]after live-surfaces[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-agenda: decode the additive `homes` object. Unnamed agenda and Refs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Today entries show the derived label instead of "Untitled Pomodoro", and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]named entries gain a muted chip with an area-hue dot. Add fixtures and [/#D7D7AF]
